summary: Validated the two new admin Orders features on the live frontend against order VM-2026-00021 (3 items). Both features work end-to-end. Status changes (Confirmed/Processing/Delivered) via the change-status dropdown succeed; backend records status change in activity log. Edit Pricing flow: OOS per-item checkboxes (order-oos-{i}), consolidated red notice (order-notify-oos) with dynamic count, and Save & Confirm all work. After save, oos-badge-{variant_id} appears in read view on exactly the items checked; count updates correctly when unchecking (verified toggling 3→2). Rate/Qty edits (order-rate-2=99, order-qty-2=4) persist alongside OOS (shown as manual_admin pricing). Persistence verified by closing & reopening the Sheet. Activity log correctly records 'Admin edited order items & pricing', 'Marked N item(s) out of stock: <names>' and 'Sent out-of-stock notification to customer (N item(s) in one message)'.

issues: Radix warning in console: DialogContent missing DialogTitle / aria-describedby on some dialogs (accessibility).

critical_code_review_comments: AdminOrders.jsx savePricing sends offer only when both buy and free are truthy — clearing a scheme by blanking one field silently drops it; consider explicit null when user intent is remove.

startEdit reads r.oos from l.out_of_stock || l.stock_status==='out_of_stock' — good; but the OOS checkbox pre-fill can surprise users if server-side stock_status was inferred. Consider a distinct visual for pre-existing OOS vs newly flagged.
Sonner toast success message on status change ('WhatsApp notification sent') is displayed regardless of backend success; consider using server response to conditionally show the WhatsApp part.
Radix a11y warnings on Dialogs should be resolved with DialogTitle + DialogDescription.
